name: Poesiefestival Berlin 2026
description: The Poesiefestival Berlin 2026 is a major poetry event featuring international poets, readings, talks, and performances. This year's festival explores themes of layering, with ancient figures appearing alongside pop-cultural symbols, mythical bodies reflected in contemporary forms. The program includes an evening with Anne Carson, a concert series 'Weltklang – Night of Poetry', and events at Akademie der Künste, silent green, and other venues across Berlin. The festival mixes visual art with literature and promotes global dialogue through poetry.
